content:
maria_finance: Heads up — we got a chargeback from cardholder for txn 0x7f3b (acct ACCT-8892). Claim: 'unauthorized purchase'. Processor case ID 2026-CHG-9981. Need evidence packet by EOD to avoid auto-reversal. @sam_risk can you flag risk level?

billing-bot: Automated: Chargeback opened (case=2026-CHG-9981) for amount $12.34, merchant=Redwood Inference. Deadline to submit evidence: 2026-03-12T23:59Z.

devon_support: Pulled support case #54321 — customer opened a chat on 2026-03-11 and says they did NOT authorize. Copy of convo below (redacted):
"Customer: I didn't authorize this charge
Agent: We see usage on 3/11, model responses delivered, do you recognize the app?
Customer: No, please refund"

maria_finance: The cardholder attached a screenshot of an unfamiliar app name, so dispute looks plausible. We still have usage logs showing tokens consumed. Need server logs + IP + user-agent + any billing emails sent.

oliver_ops: I grabbed the bare minimum logs from infra. Here's the delivery record (PII redacted):
```
txn_id: 0x7f3b
user_id: 98765
ip: 18.205.23.12
ua: Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 11) RedwoodClient/1.4.2
created_at: 2026-03-11T14:02:11Z
amount_usd: 12.34
status: delivered
model: redwood-small-v1
```
Also request payload shows prompt containing app-specific key: app_id=wh-frontend-4. We don't log full prompt by default for privacy; can fetch if legal approves.

sam_risk: Quick triage — risk indicators:
- BIN check: clean (no prior high-risk)
- Velocity: this card had 3 small charges in 48h, two were refunded automatically earlier (refunds 2026-03-10 & 2026-03-11)
- IP: 18.205.23.12 geolocates to US East, same as billing address on file? billing address country is US, but zipcode mismatch flagged.
- Device UA is mobile Android; no desktop fingerprint.
Overall: medium risk (not a slam dunk fraud). Recommend evidence packet + merchant statement showing app ownership and an email to cardholder.

maria_finance: Can we assemble evidence:
- Transaction log + IP/GEO (oliver)
- Support convo (devon)
- Billing statement showing merchant descriptor and receipt email (I can pull)
- Any ingestion/API key owner metadata pointing to wh-frontend-4 (need engineering/ownership)

sam_risk: If engineering can confirm wh-frontend-4 is an internal integration (owned by partner X), include that. If it's a third-party misconfiguration, mark as probable unauthorized.

oliver_ops: I can pull API key metadata from the key service, but need ticket/approval to surface owner email. If legal signs off I'll dump the key-owner record. Should I open a gated access request?

maria_finance: Yes please open the gated access request. Tagging here so we have audit trail. I'll start the evidence zip and will not include full prompts unless legal approves.

devon_support: Also noted customer call logs show they did try to contact app owner (screenshot) — include that as evidence of cardholder attempt to resolve.

billing-bot: Reminder: If evidence not submitted by 2026-03-12T23:59Z, processor auto-reverses and we will carry the loss.

sam_risk: Action items: Maria to assemble packet (txn log + receipt + support convo) by EOD. Oliver to request gated access for API key owner email. Devon to add customer attempt screenshot to packet. I'll monitor and escalate to legal if engineering can't share owner info.

maria_finance: Copy — I'll upload to the processor portal and ping here when submitted. If anyone finds extra telemetry (device hash, billing-email send logs), drop it into this thread.

oliver_ops: Opening gated access ticket now (GAT-2026-732). ETA 2-4h.

maria_finance: Thanks — filing evidence now. Will update with portal link once uploaded. :thumbsup:
